why_the_product_floor_was_not_lowered: The catch window at the shipped screen constants is 550ms, not ~50ms. A floor of 46ms is below TURN_DURATION_DRAIN_FLOOR_MS (250) and below the 352ms macos live sample, so it would be a vacuous compile-time guard and would unprotect ordinal 70. 250ms is an honest linux drain recommendation against this 46ms max; it is not a licence to shrink POST_MARKER_CATCH_WINDOW_FLOOR_MS. Interactive linux host-corpus reachable turn_duration tails (max 60222ms in a 2.1.201/202 kata session with away_summary + queue-operation) are not a minified-cell shape and were not used.
